verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks. Webhooks emit change events, the REST API performs writes, and internal connections are described as 'ideal for custom automations', but nothing documents a native trigger-and-action rule builder in Notion. Integration-directory and '24/7 agents' marketing lines do not describe configurable trigger/action rules, so under the partial-credit boundary these primitives earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps
